question: How many Schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
solution: The correct answer is __**12**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • India’s constitution had 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules__ at the time of commencement. • Now the Constitution of India has 448 articles in 25 parts, 12 schedules. • There are a total of __12 Schedules__ in the Indian Constitution.
